QuestInfo.name: JM's Request
QuestInfo.0: Go see JM From tha Streetz.
QuestInfo.1: JM has a job for you. Eliminate #b50 #o4230102#s#k in the Subway, collect #b20 Medicines with Weird Vibes#k, and place them inside the #rleft drawer of the bottommost row at the pharmacy#k.
QuestInfo.2: You put the medicine in the drawers. What kind of job was that, anyway?

0.0: Hey, I got a job for you. Ready?
0.1: I need you to take out #b50 Wraiths#k in the Subway and collect #b20 Medicines with Weird Vibes#k. Then take the medicine and put it in the #rleft drawer of the bottommost row in the Pharmacy#k. Your commission will be waiting for you in the drawer.

yes.0: Piece of cake, right? You don't even need to come back to see me after you're done. By the way...you aren't working with Nella lately, are you? You can't trust her, okay?

no.0: Huh? You aren't switching sides on me, are you?

1.0: (You put the Medicine with Weird Vibes in the drawer and take your commission.)

npc.0: Don't bring the medicine back to me! Put it in the #rleft drawer on the bottommost row in the Pharmacy#k.

item.0: (The drawer is empty. It looks like you actually need 20 Medicines with Weird Vibes first.)
